description: Maintainer judgements of whether each upstream PHP security fix affects Phego, with evidence. tools/upstream_diff.py reports every fix as needs_assessment; tools/test_security_assessments.py requires a record here for every security identifier in a committed engineering/compatibility/upstream-diff-*.json report.

assessments.evidence: NEWS (Core) describes state corruption via bailout, the longjmp Zend uses to abort on fatal errors. Phego shares no C code with Zend and does not use bailout, so the memory-safety defect cannot occur as written. The PHP-observable part, execution state after a fatal error during a request, belongs to W-14 (errors and shutdown) and the VM (W-17). The 8.5.12 archive adds no test named for these identifiers (no Zend/tests file matches GHSA-w8hw or GHSA-6wmf), so a regression test must be written from the advisory when it is published and run once W-14 and W-17 exist.
